facts.fact: Cameras at Harare intersections run by the AI-powered electronic traffic management system have detected violations, which are verified and then used to contact offenders for fines, said Zimbabwe Republic Police and the Home Affairs ministry.
The system had detected over four million violations by the end of September 2026, up from 2.3 million in mid-August, said police spokesperson Paul Nyathi.
